messages:
maria: Heads-up: customers are seeing SCIM user creation failures after last night's KMS rotation. Noticed start at ~04:10Z.
ash: error codes?
maria: 403 on SCIM create and update. SAML consumer logs show decrypt failures with INVALID_CONTEXT.
jamal: any more specifics in the assertion? which field is failing?
maria: the encrypted attribute 'external_id' inside the assertion. The JWE includes a 'nonce' header that appears to be base64url vs our expected base64. example (redacted): {"alg":"RSA-OAEP","enc":"A256GCM","kid":"projects/global/cryptoKeys/ri-key-v2","nonce":"Xx9_fQ--"}
kevin: that "--" is a urlsafe pad. Our KMS envelope context uses raw bytes derived from std-base64 decoding. If the asserting party switched to urlsafe, KMS will reject with INVALID_CONTEXT.
sre-oncall: KMS audit shows ~900 INVALID_CONTEXTs for ri-key-v2 between 2026-03-21T04:10Z and 04:30Z.
ash: do we know what changed client-side? vendor release notes?
maria: customer said they updated the SAML plugin on their IdP overnight. Could be a minor lib bump that switched encoding.
jamal: immediate mitigation: make our decrypt tolerant to both encodings (try urlsafe decode then std). Also capture the raw header and a hashed index for correlation in logs.
kevin: agree. implement as a small shim in saml-parser: parseNonce(n) -> try base64url then base64, return bytes. Gate behind feature flag and rollout.
ash: will add unit tests with both variants and include the exact KMS audit id so we can cross-ref.
sre-oncall: plan to monitor INVALID_CONTEXT rate and SCIM retry queue depth. I'll open alert runbook to escalate if retries grow >50.
okta-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-48 created: SCIM provisioning degradation. Okta team cc'd.
maria: also want to check RBAC side-effects: some SCIM failures caused partial provisioning leaving shadow service accounts. We need to identify orphans and ensure roles aren't accidentally elevated.
jamal: good call. I'll run a query to find service accounts that were created in our DB but not fully provisioned in Okta and mark them for cleanup. Also export audit logs for any role changes in that window.
kevin: add a safe reconciler job that checks for "created_locally && not_provisioned_remotely" and either retries or marks for manual review depending on age.
ash: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4130  includes nonce normalization, tests, and a metric saml.decrypt_nonstd_count.
maria: timeline: 1) push shim behind flag to staging, 2) run repro against customer's staging bundle, 3) if good, gradual prod rollout, 4) run reconciler for orphaned accounts and requeue SCIM events, 5) coordinate vendor fix and add regression test to SAML harness.
sre-oncall: i'll coordinate a deploy window and watch invalid_context, scim_retry_count, and orphan_account_gauge.
jamal: i'll attach the KMS audit export and a list of affected SCIM event ids to the incident for the postmortem.
kevin: also quick vuln triage note: confirm that accepting urlsafe doesn't open attack surface. We only change decoding behavior for non-secret metadata used as KMS context; still log and rate-limit malformed attempts.
maria: agree. include a short security review in PR and require approval from eng-security.
ash: merging tests now. will keep the flag off until we validate in staging.
okta-bot: Customer Okta status update posted by okta-team: investigating plugin encoding change.
maria: thanks all. sending customer-facing note acknowledging we have a mitigation and ETA for deploy. Will update incident channel with progress. :thumbsup:
